_comment: High/critical advisories on production dependencies accepted for a while, each with why it is not reachable here. scripts/check-audit.mjs fails the build on any advisory not listed, and on any allowance past its expiry. Reviewed 2026-10-16 (E1 lot B).

allow.reason: DoS in JaegerPropagator on a malformed header. The Jaeger propagator only runs when OTEL_PROPAGATORS selects it; Phantera sets no OTEL_* variable (default: tracecontext,baggage). The fixed version (2.9+) is outside the range Inngest's SDK pins; an npm override leaves an invalid tree.

Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. Used by the Prisma CLI to merge its own configuration at build and migration time; it never receives request data. The only 'fix' npm offers is a downgrade of Prisma to 6.12.
